plotHookTaken: hook.trade_war blended with hook.environmental_gauntlet — the drover
from the next village staked carrion by this village's folds and offers to buy the
frightened village's flock at half price.
Seed dice: p3 opportunity (command of the watch and a fee, at the risk of the name)

failureMetadata of steps 0 and 1 (a critical_failure at any step ends the action).

stakes.goal: hold the great fold against the wolf pack
stakes.risk: see the pack in the fold until dawn
stakes.won: held the fold gate until dawn

template.name: Wolves at the Fold

openings.rural: {actor} arrives at {location} in a hard frost.

steps.narrativeTemplate: Since the snow came, wolves take ewes from the folds each night. The pack passes the next village by. {cast:drover}, a drover from there, says the pack likes this side of the valley, and offers to buy the flock at half price. The reeve sent for {actor} to size up the watch and command it for a fee. If the folds fall under that command, {location} will think less of {actor}.
steps.successAfterimage: They found carrion staked past the last fold, left there by {cast:drover} to draw the pack.
steps.failureAfterimage: They walked the folds and the hill until dark and found only tracks.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: They found the carrion and who staked it, and {cast:drover} saw them find it.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: They found carrion staked past the last fold, and caught {cast:drover} bringing more.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: They blamed the shepherds' dogs for drawing the pack, and the shepherds have not forgiven it.

effects.label: Staked carrion by a neighbouring village's folds to draw the wolves away from home

nudges.name: Reveal The Trail
nudges.effectLine: Make the tracks of beasts plain in snow and mud, so a tracker can follow them back to where they began.

bandProse.critical_success: The tracks led {actor} to the stakes as plainly as a road.
bandProse.success: A line of tracks showed {actor} where the pack turned off the hill.
bandProse.near_miss: The tracks stayed plain until the wind rose, and {actor} spent an hour finding them again.
bandProse.failure: Fresh snow filled the tracks behind {actor} faster than they could follow.

nudges.name: Twist A Tale
nudges.effectLine: Make a liar's account slip and contradict itself, so whoever is listening hears the gap.

bandProse.success: {cast:drover} said the pack came down from the north, then said the east.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {cast:drover} changed the story halfway, then saw that {actor} had noticed.
bandProse.failure: {cast:drover} told the same story twice, word for word, and it held.
bandProse.critical_failure: {cast:drover} stumbled over the story, and the shepherds heard only {actor} pressing a guest.

steps.narrativeTemplate: The watch is a handful of farmhands with spears, lanterns and one horn. None of them has stood against wolves. At dusk the reeve, {cast:reeve}, hands the watch to {actor}. {actor} must post it on the folds before the pack comes down.
steps.successAfterimage: The watch stood at every fold by dark, and each farmhand knew where to run when the horn blew.
steps.failureAfterimage: The watch was still arguing over the lanterns when the light went.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: The watch stood by dark, but a few farmhands went home rather than stand in the snow.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: Every fold had a lantern and a spear on it by dark, and the horn hung where all could hear it.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: Half the watch refused to stand, and told {cast:reeve} so in front of the others.

critical_success.text: The carrion is pulled up, and {cast:drover} dares not stake more.

success.text: They pulled up the carrion before dusk.

near_miss.text: They found the carrion late, with the light going.

failure.text: They still do not know what draws the pack.

critical_failure.text: The shepherds will not take orders from them.

nudges.name: Guard The Flames
nudges.effectLine: Keep lamps and fires burning through wind and snow, so watchers see what comes at them.

bandProse.critical_success: No lantern on the folds went out in the wind.
bandProse.success: The lanterns burned steady on every fold through the first squall.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The lanterns burned, and showed the watch how many wolves there were.
bandProse.near_miss: The lanterns would not catch in the wind until the light was nearly gone.
bandProse.failure: The lanterns burned, but the watch had set them where the pack never came.
bandProse.critical_failure: A lantern tipped into the straw of the east fold, and the watch spent the dusk beating out the fire.

steps.narrativeTemplate: On the coldest night the whole pack comes down at once. The watch falls back to the great fold, where most of the flock is penned. {actor} must hold its barred gate until dawn. {cast:drover} waits at the end of the lane, ready to buy whatever is left.
steps.successAfterimage: The gate held until dawn, and the pack went back up the hill hungry.
steps.failureAfterimage: The gate gave way before dawn, and the pack got into the great fold.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: The gate held until dawn, but the pack took ewes from the far folds.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: The pack broke off before midnight and did not come back.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The gate fell, the watch ran, and the pack was in the fold until dawn.

critical_success.text: The watch has had time to learn its posts.

success.text: The watch took its posts in good order.

success_at_cost.text: The watch is short of hands.

near_miss.text: The watch took its places late.

failure.text: The watch never settled on its posts.

critical_failure.text: Half the watch would not stand.

nudges.name: Harden The Bar
nudges.effectLine: Make wood and iron hold past their strength, so a shut door stays shut.

bandProse.critical_success: The gate bar took the whole weight of the pack and did not crack.
bandProse.success: The gate bar bowed under the rush, and held.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The bar held all night, but the watch left the far folds to stand behind it.
bandProse.near_miss: The bar held, but the hinge post split, and the gate hung by one side until dawn.
bandProse.failure: The bar held, and the post beside it gave way.
bandProse.critical_failure: The bar held until the post tore out of the frozen ground and took the gate with it.

nudges.name: Raise Morale
nudges.effectLine: Wake their hopeful nature, so the people beside them take heart and hold their ground.

bandProse.success: {actor} laughed at the wolves through the gate, and the watch laughed with them.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The watch stayed at the gate because {actor} did.
bandProse.failure: {actor} stood at the gate alone for a while before the watch came back to it.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being Hopeful, they expect the gate to hold till dawn.
Being Bitter, they expect the gate to fall before dawn.

template.description: An expert three-step iron job for a village: find what draws a wolf pack to its folds (a drover from the next village has staked carrion past the last fold), post a frightened watch on the folds, then hold the great fold's barred gate until dawn while the drover waits to buy what is left. A held fold wins the village's regard, leaves it Under Watch, and puts the drover's secret in the mortal's hands to keep or spend. A fallen fold costs the village's regard and sells the flock cheap.
